summary: Separate delegation, leases, authority budgets and commercial entitlement

delivery.outcome: Authority v1 models optional fenced leases and narrow-only protected delegation without treating execution budgets as commercial entitlement or usage settlement.
nonGoals: Define product prices, usage units or customer package balances
Implement a Subactor grant store, lease coordinator or billing service
Allow an executor to issue or widen its own authority

architecture.decision: Keep lease policy explicit on every grant but allow a closed no-lease variant. Model delegation as protected provenance on a child grant; actual subset comparison remains a protected issuer/evaluator responsibility bound to the parent digest.
interfaceChanges: Relax lease policy and add optional delegation provenance in wellmanifest.authority/grant/v1
architecture.rollback: Revert ticket-006; existing required-lease grants remain valid throughout.
